title: Sneaker with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sole -->
  <rect x="8" y="72" width="84" height="16" rx="8" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
  <rect x="8" y="72" width="84" height="5" rx="3" fill="#b0b0b0"/>
  <!-- shoe body -->
  <path d="M12 72 Q10 45 30 38 L45 34 Q55 28 65 30 L78 38 Q88 46 90 72 Z" fill="#e8443a"/>
  <!-- toe cap -->
  <path d="M12 72 Q10 55 22 48 L30 64 Q28 72 30 72 Z" fill="#f06a58"/>
  <!-- heel patch -->
  <path d="M78 38 Q88 46 90 72 L76 72 Q76 50 78 38 Z" fill="#c22c24"/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <path d="M42 36 Q50 28 62 30 L60 48 Q50 44 42 48 Z" fill="#ff7f6e"/>
  <!-- laces -->
  <line x1="46" y1="40" x2="60" y2="37" stroke="#f5f5f5" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="46" y1="46" x2="60" y2="43" stroke="#f5f5f5" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="46" y1="52" x2="58" y2="50" stroke="#f5f5f5" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <path d="M70 40 Q74 54 73 70" stroke="#f5c542" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <ellipse cx="44" cy="58" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="58" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="59" rx="2.5" ry="3" fill="#3a1a1a"/>
  <ellipse cx="63" cy="59" rx="2.5" ry="3" fill="#3a1a1a"/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="57" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="57" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 66 Q53 73 62 66" stroke="#3a1a1a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="64" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ffb3a0" opacity="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="64" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ffb3a0" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
